_note: Community disease watch: the illnesses the app asks about, their case definitions, and the alert rules the dashboard uses. Versioned: change 'version' of a syndrome whenever its definition, its 'ask' wording or its triggers change, and change 'alertRules.version' whenever a rule changes. Old versions stay listed in 'history' so old reports can still be read. 'ask' is narrated (clip id ui.syn.<id>). 'topics' = topic pages that show the question; 'symptoms' = symptom-finder pictures/searches that show the question and count as a weaker 'search' signal. 'active': false = defined for the dashboard but not asked in the app (no app content for it yet). Run tools/validate.py and tools/build.py after any change (build.py also writes server/surveillance-defs.js).

ask.fa: تب و دانه‌های سرخ در تمام بدن؛ شاید سرخکان باشد.
ask.ps: تبه او په ټول بدن سرې دانې؛ کېدای شي شري وي.
ask.en: Fever and a red rash all over the body; it may be measles.

syndromes.definition: Any person with fever and a maculopapular (non-vesicular) rash, or in whom a health worker suspects measles. App wording: fever and a red rash all over the body.

source.title: WHO Vaccine-Preventable Diseases Surveillance Standards: Measles (2018)

ask.fa: سه بار یا بیشتر اسهال آبکی در یک روز، بدون خون.
ask.ps: په یوه ورځ کې درې ځله یا ډېر اوبلن نس ناستی، بې له وینې.
ask.en: Three or more watery stools in one day, with no blood.

syndromes.definition: Three or more loose or watery stools in 24 hours, without visible blood.

source.title: WHO (2012) Outbreak surveillance and response in humanitarian emergencies: guidelines for EWARN implementation, standard case definitions

ask.fa: اسهال، و در مدفوع خون دیده می‌شود.
ask.ps: نس ناستی، او په ډکو متیازو کې وینه ښکاري.
ask.en: Diarrhoea, with blood in the stool.

syndromes.definition: Acute diarrhoea with visible blood in the stool.

source.title: WHO (2012) Outbreak surveillance and response in humanitarian emergencies: guidelines for EWARN implementation, standard case definitions

ask.fa: سرفه، همراه با نفس تیز یا نفس کشیدن به سختی.
ask.ps: ټوخی، له ژر ژر یا سخت سا اخیستلو سره.
ask.en: Cough with fast or difficult breathing.

syndromes.definition: Cough or difficult breathing with fast breathing (IMCI cut-offs by age) or lower chest indrawing (ARI-pneumonia). Lay report, breathing not counted by a health worker.

source.title: WHO IMCI Chart Booklet (2014) and WHO EMRO Afghanistan outbreak situation reports (ARI-pneumonia)

ask.fa: تب ناگهانی همراه با خونریزی از بینی، بیره یا زیر پوست.
ask.ps: ناڅاپي تبه او له پوزې، ورېژو یا پوستکي لاندې وینه بهېدل.
ask.en: Sudden fever with bleeding from the nose, gums or under the skin.

syndromes.definition: Sudden onset of fever with bleeding (nose, gums, skin, vomit or stool), especially after a tick bite or contact with animal blood or a sick person. Immediately notifiable.

source.title: WHO fact sheet: Crimean-Congo haemorrhagic fever; WHO EMRO Afghanistan outbreak situation reports (suspected CCHF)

ask.fa: گزیدن یا پنجه زدن سگ یا حیوان دیگر.
ask.ps: د سپي یا بل څاروي چیچل یا منګول وهل.
ask.en: A bite or scratch from a dog or another animal.

syndromes.definition: Any person bitten or scratched by a dog or another animal that may carry rabies (possible rabies exposure).

source.title: WHO fact sheet: Rabies; WHO Expert Consultation on Rabies, third report (2018)

ask.fa: تب و لرزه که دوباره و دوباره می‌آید.
ask.ps: تبه او لړزه چې بیا بیا راځي.
ask.en: Fever and shivering that keep coming back.

syndromes.definition: Fever in a person living in or coming from a malaria area, with no other obvious cause. Not asked in the app yet: the book has no malaria page, and 'fever with no other cause' cannot be told apart by families.

source.title: WHO (2012) Outbreak surveillance and response in humanitarian emergencies: guidelines for EWARN implementation, standard case definitions

ask.en: A cough for 2 weeks or more.

syndromes.definition: Cough lasting 2 weeks or more (presumptive tuberculosis, needs testing). Not an outbreak disease; shown for trends only.

source.title: WHO consolidated guidelines on tuberculosis, Module 2: screening (2021)

ask.fa: چشم یا پوست تازه زرد شده است (نه نوزاد).
ask.ps: سترګې یا پوستکی تازه ژېړ شوي (نوی زېږېدلی ماشوم نه).
ask.en: Eyes or skin have recently turned yellow (not a newborn baby).

syndromes.definition: Acute onset of yellow eyes or skin, with no known other cause, in anyone older than one month (acute jaundice syndrome; hepatitis A or E are common causes).

source.title: WHO (2012) Outbreak surveillance and response in humanitarian emergencies: guidelines for EWARN implementation, standard case definitions (acute jaundice syndrome)

syndromes.definition: Sudden fever with a stiff neck, or with altered consciousness or other meningeal signs (bulging fontanelle in infants).

source.title: WHO Vaccine-Preventable Diseases Surveillance Standards: Meningitis (2018)

ask.fa: زخم پوست که بعد از دو هفته جور نشده است.
ask.ps: د پوستکي زخم چې له دوو اونیو وروسته نه دی جوړ شوی.
ask.en: A skin sore that has not healed after two weeks.

syndromes.definition: A papule, nodule or ulcer of the skin that has not healed after 2 weeks in a person living in or coming from an area where leishmaniasis occurs.

source.title: WHO fact sheet: Leishmaniasis; WHO Manual for case management of cutaneous leishmaniasis in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region (2014)

ask.fa: دست یا پای طفل ناگهان سست شده و حرکت نمی‌کند.
ask.ps: د ماشوم لاس یا پښه ناڅاپه سسته شوې او نه خوځېږي.
ask.en: A child's arm or leg has suddenly gone floppy and will not move.

syndromes.definition: Any child under 15 with sudden onset of floppy (flaccid) weakness or paralysis of an arm or leg, or any person in whom a health worker suspects polio. Immediately notifiable. Not asked in the app yet: the book has no page on sudden weakness; add one before turning this on.

source.title: WHO Vaccine-Preventable Diseases Surveillance Standards: Poliomyelitis (2018)

alertRules.unit: one syndrome in one district in one ISO week (Monday to Sunday, by the report day on the phone), all age groups together; de-duplicated and voided reports are not counted

rules.text: Any single report of suspected CCHF or acute flaccid paralysis in a district in a week.
Two or more suspected measles reports in the same district in the same week.
Three or more reports of one syndrome in a district in a week AND at least twice the baseline (the mean weekly count of the previous 4 weeks).

suppression.text: In shareable exports any count from 1 to 4 is shown as '<5'. Zero is shown as 0.
